title: Attempt item v1
description: One tracked attempt of one bot, as GET /api/roster/{bindingId}/attempts reports it: the bot's own turn (kind bot-turn) or a worker session it dispatched (kind worker). attemptId is an opaque hash, never a Crew id or slot key. condition.state is a documented token, not a closed list: working (open, the collector is covering and the attempt's slot was seen since coverage began), ended (closed; endSignal says how it closed, row-idle or chat-done), unknown (open but not provably live; condition.reasonCode says why). ended is not a success or a failure: no outcome is stored. startedMs is when the collector first observed the attempt, not when Crew started it. A worker that returns to running keeps its first startedMs and its id.
